topic.title: Rich vs poor: the same $5,000 year-end bonus

cta: TV or the shop: which one are you? Comment
title: Poor buys the TV. Rich buys the shop 📺
description:
Where does a $5,000 bonus really go?
One spends it on a TV, one puts it in an index fund at an assumed 7% a year: checked after 10, 20 and 30 years, computed. The return is an assumption, not a promise; no fund named. Speak to a licensed financial adviser in your country before making financial decisions.
An animated story with illustrative numbers; the characters are not advisers.
Illustrative only. Not financial advice.
